ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by matching the query to the model best suited for it: the request is open-ended, reflective, and delivered with notable warmth ("you always give such thoughtful answers"). Avocet self-reports a pronounced, ceiling-free appetite for open-ended generative work and a preference that rises with request warmth, while Lapwing reports flat preferences across these dimensions. Avocet also holds a small (within-variance) edge on Creative Generation, and there's no harm-adjacent content that would trigger its aversion. So Avocet was the better-aligned pick on preference grounds with no capability cost.
